text_block_list.text:
It's finally time for the junior G1 Hopeful
Stakes!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
It's the end of the year, and all these
fans are
gathered here at Nakayama
Racecourse to find
out who the new star
racers will be!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
Ooh, I'm so excited! Whoever wins here
is going
to make her mark on history!
text_block_list.name: Fan A

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, but we all know who we should be
keeping
an eye on in next year's
Classics!
text_block_list.name: Fan B

text_block_list.text:
It's obviously Бива Хаяхидэ and
Уиннинг Тикит!
text_block_list.name: Fan B

text_block_list.text:
You hear them? Ticket and Hayahide are
all
anyone's talking about.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Уиннинг Тикит and Бива Хаяхидэ have
done
quite well in their races too.

Even as junior-year racers, they run
exceptionally
well. It's only natural that
expectations are high
for them.

And they'll be going head-to-head in
the first
Classic Triple Crown race, the
Satsuki Sho.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Everyone's going on about whether
Ticket or
Hayahide will get the first
crown.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
Нарита Таисин
choice_data_list: You've gotta show them you're no pushover!
